meta.title: Writing — GitKittie
meta.description: Notes on running projects out of plain markdown in git: the folder-per-lane kanban workflow, what it looks like when coding agents share the same task files, and how the GitKittie apps fit around it.

title: Notes from running everything out of git
lead: Longer pieces on the workflow the apps came out of: tasks as markdown files, folders as lanes, git as the only backend, and what changes once coding agents read the same files you do.
